extDesc.message: Collect images and videos from web pages and send them to OpenWallpaper's cache folder over a local WebSocket.

emptyImageHint.message: Some images are loaded by styles or scripts. Scroll the page and refresh.

emptyVideoHint.message: Video URLs are often hidden in API JSON. Play or scroll the page and they will be captured.

sendFailed.message: Sending failed. Make sure OpenWallpaper is running.

batchSaved.message: Started saving {count} media files plus the whole page HTML

disconnected.message: Not connected. Please start the app.

bgTimeout.message: Connection timed out. Make sure OpenWallpaper is running.

bgDisconnected.message: The connection to OpenWallpaper was closed.

bgCannotConnect.message: Cannot reach the local OpenWallpaper service. Start the app first.

bgWriteTimeout.message: Timed out waiting for the client to write.
